chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Najran, from 'Asim, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, from 'Ali عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, the Imam transmitting the report
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific attached to the Imam
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: 'Ali عليه السلام, the final authority cited in this report
key_terms.عَنْ: from; indicating transmission in the sanad
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: the same as it; an abbreviation indicating the matn is identical to a previous narration

ai.seo_question: What does the abbreviated hadith wording "مِثْلَهُ" mean in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This report cites a chain of transmission reaching Abu Ja'far عليه السلام from 'Ali عليه السلام, but the matn itself is abbreviated with the word "mithlahu," meaning it is the same as the previous narration. Its significance is therefore dependent on the immediately preceding hadith in this chapter on shared liability in injuries.
